title: Provoleta
description: Provoleta is a dish from Argentina featuring provolone, baguette, tomato. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 12 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Grill the marinated portions from the preceding steps, turning to cook evenly and checking the safe internal temperature.
Stir in these seasonings and additions. Taste, adjust the balance and let the dish stand briefly before serving.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
